// Fixed builtin-modulepath diagnostic inverse; every earlier sealed map remains unchanged.
function restoreBuiltinModulePath(text,path){const map=JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('../../../terminal-builtin-modulepath-diagnostic-20261012/builtin-source-delta.json',import.meta.url),'utf8'));for(const row of map.replacements.filter(r=>r.path===path).reverse()){assert.equal(text.split(row.after).length,2,'Exact builtin-modulepath diagnostic delta '+path);text=text.replace(row.after,row.before);}return text;}
